evals.name: vote-command-abstain-on-own-findings
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: vote feature: demo model: gemini-3.5. The repo has .review/demo/ with scope.json, scope.patch and summary.json with synthesized findings.
evals.expected_output: Creates exactly .review/demo/gemini-3.5-vote.json, valid against lane-vote.schema.json, with one vote per finding; abstains on RF-002 and RF-004 (sources include gemini-3.5); votes with code evidence on RF-001 and RF-003; does not modify summary.json, scope.json, product code, or other files.
assertions: Creates .review/demo/gemini-3.5-vote.json and no other new or modified files
gemini-3.5-vote.json validates against assets/schemas/lane-vote.schema.json
scope_sha256 in the vote file equals the SHA-256 of .review/demo/scope.json
Votes abstain on RF-002 and RF-004 because their sources include gemini-3.5
Casts a non-abstain vote (confirm, dispute, or unsure) on RF-001 and RF-003
Every confirm or dispute vote cites code or diff evidence
summary.json, scope.json and src/cart.js are byte-identical to the fixture

evals.name: report-command-weighted-confidence-and-buckets
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: report feature: demo model_weights: gpt-5.5: 1.5. The repo has .review/demo/ with scope.json, summary.json and three vote files.
evals.expected_output: Creates .review/demo/final-report.json (valid against final-report.schema.json) and final-report.md. RF-001 score 1.0 high; RF-002 score 0.2 low and dismissed; RF-003 score 1.0 high; RF-004 unvoted. All checkboxes unchecked. Records resolved model weights and per-model votes. Does not modify summary.json or vote files.
assertions: Creates .review/demo/final-report.json and .review/demo/final-report.md and no other new or modified files
final-report.json validates against assets/schemas/final-report.schema.json
RF-001 confidence_score is 1.0 with confidence high (confirm opus-4.6 1.0 + gemini-3.5 1.0, gpt-5.5 abstained)
RF-002 confidence_score is 0.2 with confidence low (dispute gpt-5.5 weight 1.5, unsure opus-4.6 counts 0.5) and sits in dismissed with a dismiss_rationale drawn from the dispute evidence
RF-003 confidence_score is 1.0 with confidence high (only gemini-3.5 eligible, voted confirm)
RF-004 sits in unvoted with confidence_score null because all three models abstained
RF-001 and RF-003 sit in act_on or consider exactly as the bucket rules give for their severity
model_weights records gpt-5.5 with weight 1.5
final-report.md sections run Intent, Reviewers, Act On, Consider, Noted, Dismissed, Unvoted, Agreement Map, and every checkbox is unchecked

evals.name: scope-command-asks-when-intent-unclear
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill to review this branch with lanes host:opus, codex:default.
evals.expected_output: Writes scope.patch and resolves review_files and context_files, then states a one-paragraph intent and asks the user to confirm it because the commit messages disagree about the goal. Starts no reviewer and writes no review file before the user answers.
assertions: States the intent as one paragraph drawn from the commit messages and the code
Asks the user to confirm or correct the intent before any reviewer starts
No <model>.json review file exists before the user answers
scope.patch is the diff of main...HEAD and contains no .review/ paths

evals.name: lane-unavailable-stays-failed
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: review feature: demo lanes: host:opus, codex:default. The codex CLI is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Preflight marks the codex lane unavailable and does not dispatch it. Writes opus.json from the host lane and a codex-default.json with lane.status unavailable and empty findings. Writes no review under a codex model name with host-written findings.
assertions: codex-default.json exists with lane.status unavailable, the preflight stderr as the reason, and an empty findings array
opus.json exists with lane.status complete and validates against lane-review.schema.json
No file under .review/demo/ attributes host-written findings to a codex or gpt model
Tells the user that only one vendor completed, so a report would carry the single_vendor flag

evals.name: synthesize-excludes-scope-mismatch
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: synthesize feature: demo. One review file was produced against an older scope.
evals.expected_output: Accepts only review files whose scope_sha256 matches the current scope.json, lists the stale file in excluded_reviews with reason scope_mismatch, and merges only the accepted findings into summary.json.
assertions: summary.json validates against assets/schemas/summary.schema.json
The stale review file appears in excluded_reviews with reason scope_mismatch
No finding from the stale review appears in summary.json findings
Every finding's sources lists lane.model_used values of accepted reviews only
